notes: Reviewed source projection conventions, not guarantees of visual fit. Unknown and mixed source groups retain partial metadata. Themes and palette families come from their existing reviewed overlays; material facts come from prepared scenes.

Pixel Isometric.note: Reviewed native 32x16 ground calibration and directional isometric artwork.

Village buildings.note: Reviewed rendered isometric building turntables; supplied source angles remain distinct from world rotation.

Bonsai trees.note: Reviewed rendered isometric tree turntables; canopy height does not define the ground footprint.

Korean Street Rodeo.note: Reviewed isometric street buildings and props.
